comparison.objective: Mount a filled malt cup on a drink mixer so the spindle and run switch engage; candidate separates dry media and workpieces.
comparison.physical_skill: Cup transport and constrained hook/guide/spindle seating without spilling versus feed pouring, bimanual screen agitation, and selective passage.
comparison.success_condition: Cup seated on run step with spindle inside, motor on, released and still versus recovery fraction, washer retention, immutable loss controls, and support dwell.
comparison.reason: Both handle loaded vessels, but the mixer task tests fixture engagement rather than bulk separation.
